answer_summary: Y = hexakis(6-O-tert-butyldimethylsilyl)-2,3-anhydro-alpha-cyclodextrin: per unit, C6 carries CH2-O-Si(CH3)2C(CH3)3 (TBS on the primary OH; six Si total), the 2- and 3-OH are fused into a 2,3-epoxide with inversion at BOTH C2 and C3 (allo configuration, both new C-O bonds on the up face of the chair template), the alpha configuration at C1 is retained, the C6 arm is up at C5, and no free OH remains; all bonds single. The explicit 102-vertex molecular graph is proved equal to the printed formula C72H132O24Si6.

trusted_general_law: Fuerst-Plattner trans-diaxial epoxide opening, consistent with the printed alpha-cycloaltrin product that follows Y in the scheme
